intent: Reproduce and fix the real-world failure where first-observable-tick or near-instant lethal threats can kill before Predictive Survival establishes server-authoritative protection. Separate deterministic fuse/wind-up threats from adversarial triggerable burst threats, add realistic exact-runtime regressions, and preserve fail-closed timing semantics.
release_reason: Human-authorized release: repository owner confirmed no agent is currently working this scope; releasing stale generation-5 lease so the approved instant-burst implementation can proceed.
